name: Lazarus
description: Create and build Lazarus projects, headless. New: console program, form application, unit (never overwrites). Build a Lazarus project (.lpi) or package (.lpk) with lazbuild, headless. The whole compiler output, warnings and hints included, is saved as a text file, and a line '[exit code N]' is added at the end, so a failed build still gives you the messages to work with (an agent can read them and propose the fix).

presets.label: New console program (in a project folder)
presets.description: Writes NAME.lpr and NAME.lpi into the folder. Input: the project folder; name in the extra-arguments box (default project1). Never overwrites.

presets.label: New Lazarus form application
presets.description: Writes NAME.lpi, NAME.lpr, unit1.pas and unit1.lfm (a form with a label and a button) into the folder. Input: the project folder; name in the extra-arguments box (default project1). Never overwrites.

presets.label: New unit (class skeleton)
presets.description: Writes NAME.pas with a class skeleton into the folder. Input: the project folder; name in the extra-arguments box (default unit1). Never overwrites.

presets.label: Build project (.lpi)
presets.description: lazbuild on the project file, default build mode. Messages are kept even when the build fails.

presets.label: Build, errors and warnings only
presets.description: Same, with the compiler's hints and notes left out (lazbuild -q), for a short list to act on

presets.label: Rebuild everything (clean)
presets.description: lazbuild -B: recompile every unit, not just what changed
